requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-849-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-849-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2167-4548-5233-5721.easyPrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{B} (but see notes).
2167-4548-5233-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing each land you control, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{B}.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, milling three cards and returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {1}{G}.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat
2167-4548-5233-5721.notes: Each legendary creature you control reduces the amount of mana required by {1}, up to a maximum of {3}. Each loop also has a chance to generate more mana than the one before it due to additional milled lands, so if you have excess mana you can begin the loop without the required number of lands and have a chance to achieve the infinite loop through milling.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
728-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

728-1808-3000.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1829-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

777-3532-5078-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7060-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

140-1824-2530-7359.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
140-1824-2530-7359.notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
140-1824-2530-7359.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Tablet of the Guilds triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-5220-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-5527-7329.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-5527-7329.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-4846-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-7296.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1020-2866-2906-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1020-2866-2906-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Rakdos.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Rakdos.
Repeat.

1734-5147-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2468-3094-3139.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking The Great Henge and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-5477-6791.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

440-1339-5231-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-5231-6752.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1077-6085-6086-6087.notablePrerequisites: Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
1077-6085-6086-6087.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2896-5145-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-2043-5393.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Cosmium Kiln that is a 1/1 Soldier.
When the token Cosmium Kiln enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the Cosmium Kiln token and the Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

880-2692-3470.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1432-2436-4513.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of two or greater.
1432-2436-4513.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Marwyn.
Repeat.

38-1069-4763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts, one of which must be an Equipment.
38-1069-4763.description:
Activate any Equipment you control's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Skirk Prospector.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Koll triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
Repeat.

1605-2560-3059.description:
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to twice its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

579-1247-4289.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
579-1247-4289.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Repeat.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)
